meta.note: Rule coverage is intentionally scoped to Tier 1/2 (appliance domain) after v2 fix -- see script docstring for the v1 cross-domain bug this fixed. IMPORTANT: this rule table overlaps substantially with the MPN-prefix hints given to the LLM in the enrichment prompts, so the calibration metric below reflects INTERNAL CONSISTENCY, not independent ground-truth validation -- see module docstring.

calibration_metric.description: Of rows LLM tagged HIGH confidence AND we could independently rule-check, % where the independent rule agrees. NOTE: 'independent' here means a separately-coded rule table, not a separately-sourced signal -- see caveat in meta.note above.
